assistant.title: AI assistant
assistant.lede: Ask anything about your account, billing, GST or orders. Answers come from our help articles, as you type.
assistant.subjectFallback: Question from the AI assistant chat
assistant.transcriptHead: Raised from an AI assistant chat. Transcript:
assistant.hello: Hi {{name}}, what can I help with?
assistant.intro: I answer from SmartCC's help articles and show you which ones. If I can't solve it, I'll turn this chat into a ticket for our team.
assistant.prompt1: My payment went through but my plan is still inactive
assistant.prompt2: How do I download a GST invoice?
assistant.prompt3: My order shows delivered but I haven't received it
assistant.disclaimer: AI answers can be wrong. Enter to send, Shift + Enter for a new line.
assistant.suggestTicket: Not solved? Our team can take it from here.
assistant.rateBody: You've asked a lot of questions in a short time. Try again in a few minutes.
assistant.rateBodyIn: You've asked a lot of questions in a short time. Try again in {{s}} s.
assistant.unavailableTitle: The AI assistant is unavailable right now
assistant.unavailableBody: Raise a ticket and a person will answer, or search the help articles.

auth.heroFoot: Help articles are open to everyone — no sign-in needed.

home.quickBody: Most billing and GST questions are answered in the Help Center.

help.noMatchBody: Try fewer or different words, or ask us directly — we'll pick it up from here.

newTicket.lede: Tell us what's going on. We'll check the help articles while you type.
newTicket.subject: Subject
newTicket.subjectPlaceholder: e.g. Payment deducted but plan inactive
newTicket.descriptionHint: Include order or invoice numbers if you have them.

newTicket.footnote: You'll get a ticket number and a response time right away.
newTicket.submitFailed: Couldn't submit your ticket. Try again.
newTicket.responseHint: We set the priority from what you describe; urgent issues jump the queue.

actions.confirmBody: We'll mark it resolved. If the problem comes back, just reply and it reopens.

profile.phoneHint: International format, e.g. +91 98765 43210. Our support team may call you on it.
